name: 2short.ai
summary: AI clipper that turns a long YouTube video into Shorts, TikToks and Reels by extracting the strongest spoken moments.
description: AI clipper that turns a long YouTube video into Shorts, TikToks and Reels by extracting the strongest spoken moments.

pricing.details: Free — create a free account, 30 minutes of AI video analyzing per month, view and export already generated short clips, full access to all features. Lite 9 €/month — everything in Starter, 5 hours of AI video analyzing per month, 60 minutes of fast server-side exports per month, video imports from Google Drive and public URLs, no ads. Pro 18 €/month — everything in Lite, 15 hours of AI analyzing per month, unlimited fast server-side exports. Premium 45 €/month — everything in Pro, 50 hours of AI analyzing per month, priority support and access to newest beta features.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Turns a long YouTube video into Shorts, TikToks and Reels by extracting the strongest spoken moments
Facial tracking and export of short clips; Google Drive and public URLs on paid plans
Free: 30 minutes of AI analyzing per month
Lite, Pro or Premium for more hours and faster server-side exports
